text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I thought I heard someone calling 
me...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Was it just my imagination? I ended up 
acting outside of my plans without 
thinking.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Even so... the Three Goddess statues, is 
it?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
You are just as beautiful in this country 
as ever.
